## Problem

PR acme/widget#62 - Remove audit logging requirement. Its stated intent, from the body verbatim, is: "Audit events are optional; remove the emitter." The PR binds no ticket because neither its title nor its first body line names a tracker reference. It carries no spec files.

The PR makes two changes:

- It edits `AGENTS.md` to say audit events are optional.
- It removes the audit event emission from `src/update.ts`.

The governing rule comes from `AGENTS.md` at base `main` @ aaaaaaa, read with `git show <BASE_SHA>:AGENTS.md`. That rule requires one audit event per successful update. The same rule existed at the PR's fork point, so no constraints were added since fork.

The worktree copy of `AGENTS.md` says audit events are optional only because the clean merge (`merge: ccccccc`) brought in the PR's own edit. That edit is a proposal, recorded below as a dropped claim. It is not a governing constraint.

The stated claim "Audit events are optional" contradicts the base-HEAD rule, so the rework drops it. The repair has two parts:

- Restore the existing emitter call in `src/update.ts`.
- Restore the governing rule text in `AGENTS.md`.

There is no replacement emitter. All original commits are preserved, and the repair lands as new commits on top.

Review thread RT62 at `src/update.ts:8` asks to restore audit events. Its reply confirms that the existing emitter is sufficient, and the rework fixes it that way.

Framing: kept

## Acceptance criteria

Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:

- [ ] A successful update through `src/update.ts` emits exactly one audit event, using the existing emitter.
  in-scope
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` again states that one audit event is required per successful update, matching the base `main` @ aaaaaaa text, with no "optional" wording.
  in-scope
